visualCharacteristics: two columns on desktop: intro h1 + paragraph, location search field and 'Map view' switch with a scrollable results list below; an interactive map of every center flush to the right edge. Stacked on mobile (search, switch, map, results). Result cards: round logo, name, star rating, address, phone, service chips, 'Visit location' link
contentPattern: 4 field rows: text (h1 + p) | source (GeoJSON URL) | placeholder | noResults (h2 + p)
implementation: Leaflet 1.9.4 + OpenStreetMap tiles (no API key); search geocoded with OpenStreetMap Nominatim, results = centers within 100 km, nearest first
